scope: Functional load coverage addendum, not a retroactive performance baseline
reference_definition: Conservative serial rate observed with zero rejected/pending inputs; not maximum host capacity
host_condition: Three offline reliability soaks running; timings unsuitable for controlled A/B
interpretation: Nonzero sessions remain explicit outcomes. Uncertainty/overload cases require gate and reconciliation, never a performance PASS. Burst need not overflow this conservative reference; capacity boundary is proven separately with controlled queue barriers.
